description: This file defines an abstract class 'TbLatestChart' for rendering and managing latest chart visualizations using ECharts in an Angular project. It includes methods for data setup, chart rendering, resizing, and interaction handling.

classes.name: TbLatestChart
classes.description: An abstract class for creating and managing latest chart visualizations with features like data setup, chart rendering, resizing, and interaction handling.

methods.name: prepareValueFormat
methods.description: Prepares the value formatter based on widget context units and decimals.

methods.name: setupData
methods.description: Initializes data items and legend items based on data sources and settings.

methods.name: getLegendItems
methods.description: Returns the current legend items.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates data items with latest data and refreshes the chart series.

methods.name: keyEnter
methods.description: Highlights a data series based on the data key.

methods.name: keyLeave
methods.description: Removes highlight from a data series based on the data key.

methods.name: toggleKey
methods.description: Enables or disables a data series based on the data key.

methods.name: destroy
methods.description: Disposes of chart and resize observer resources.

methods.name: resize
methods.description: Triggers resize handling for the chart.

methods.name: onItemClick
methods.description: Sets a callback for item click events.

methods.name: updateSeriesData
methods.description: Updates the chart series data and legend totals.

methods.name: drawChart
methods.description: Initializes and renders the chart with options and event handlers.

methods.name: onChartClick
methods.description: Handles click events on the chart, invoking item click callback if applicable.

methods.name: onResize
methods.description: Handles resize events, resizing or redrawing the chart accordingly.

methods.name: initSettings
methods.description: Placeholder for initializing settings, to be implemented by subclasses.

methods.name: initialShapeWidth
methods.description: Returns initial width of the chart shape.

methods.name: initialShapeHeight
methods.description: Returns initial height of the chart shape.

methods.name: forceRedrawOnResize
methods.description: Determines if chart should be redrawn on resize.

methods.name: beforeResize
methods.description: Hook called before resizing the chart.

methods.name: afterResize
methods.description: Hook called after resizing the chart.

methods.name: afterDrawChart
methods.description: Hook called after the chart is drawn.

methods.name: afterUpdateSeriesData
methods.description: Hook called after series data is updated.

methods.name: defaultSettings
methods.description: Abstract method to provide default settings for the chart.

methods.name: prepareLatestChartOption
methods.description: Abstract method to prepare chart options.

methods.name: doUpdateSeriesData
methods.description: Abstract method to update series data.
